---
title: Basic
---

Interact with a Three.js cylinder managed by an XR Blocks Script. Hold a
selection to turn it blue; release to choose another color. The example owns
and disposes its geometry and material.

Enter the simulator and click, or use a tracked XR selection source. See
[simulator controls](/sdk/simulator) for movement and input modes.

[Developer quickstart](/get-started/developer-quickstart) · [Example catalog](/examples)
